annotations.title: Add the website to the user's CookiePilot account

description: Adds a website to the confirmed account (setup_token must be ready) and makes it the default for the other tools. Defaults to the website given to create_account. An already added website (also as www. or without it) is returned as is. Fails with an explanation when the plan's website limit is used up.

hostname.description: Website hostname, e.g. example.com; defaults to the website added last (or given to create_account)

name: add_domain
